items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: I did an album with them, but I don’t know if that was it.

ctx.x: Did you happen to play on an album with Jackie & Roy called “Time and Love?” Does that ring a bell with you? It was a CTI thing I think.
I did an album with them, but I don’t know if that was it. Do you remember the rest of the guys on it?
I can’t think of the arranger right now, but I’ll come back to it. It’s a great record. Wayne Shorter, Charles McPherson, I mean, boy that’s a varied list of people and different styles too.
